atAGlance: Nem nướng is grilled pork sausage, usually with smoke, sweet garlic seasoning, herbs, and thick Nha Trang-style peanut-garlic dip.
whatItIs: Nem nướng is grilled pork sausage, often smoky, bouncy, and slightly sweet, served with herbs, rice paper or noodles, pickles, and a thick peanut-garlic dip in many shops.
howToEnjoy: Wrap the sausage with herbs and rice paper if served, or mix it into noodles. Use the thick dip slowly because it is rich and sweet-savory.
howLocalsOrder: Order nem nướng as a shared grilled pork plate or ask for the cuốn version if you want to wrap. Say no peanuts or no chili before the dip arrives.
worthKnowing: Nha Trang and south-central versions are especially famous, often because of the dip and crunchy roll fillings.
